grammar.q:
Joe: Is our new house big?
Liz: Yes, ____.
grammar.tip: 肯定簡答 Yes, it is，不可縮寫成 it's

grammar.q:
Ann: ____ your mother a housewife?
Sue: Yes, ____.
grammar.tip: your mother 單數用 Is；媽媽→she

grammar.q: Patty and I are classmates. Miss Young is ____ teacher.
grammar.tip: Patty and I = we → 所有格 our

grammar.q:
Lisa: Is that tall boy your brother?
Earl: Yes, ____.
grammar.tip: boy 是男生，簡答代名詞用 he

grammar.q:
Bob: Who's ____?
Ann: She's our new teacher.
grammar.tip: 答句用 She → 問的是女性

grammar.q:
Ron: ____ you a housewife?
Liz: Yes, ____.
grammar.tip: you 配 Are；肯定簡答 I am 不可縮寫

grammar.q:
Gina: Is our school big?
Beth: No, ____ isn't. It ____ small.
grammar.tip: 簡答用代名詞 it；學校小→It is small

grammar.q:
Bob: ____ our classroom?
Ken: ____ really big.
grammar.tip: How's 問狀況；classroom 單數→It's

grammar.q:
Ken: Is that beautiful girl happy?
Pat: No, ____.
grammar.tip: No 之後要說不快樂→she's very sad

grammar.q:
Jill: ____ you a student, Hank?
Hank: Yes, ____.
grammar.tip: you 配 Are；Yes, I'm 不可單獨結尾

grammar.q:
Alex: Your wife is ____.
Mark: Thanks.
grammar.tip: 稱讚太太美麗，對方才說謝謝

grammar.q: You are a student. I'm a student, ____.
grammar.tip: 肯定句「也」放句尾用 too

grammar.q: Charles is my ____. He is my father's brother.
grammar.tip: 爸爸的兄弟 = uncle 叔伯

grammar.q: Mr. and Mrs. Lin are ____ and ____. Their son is a doctor.
grammar.tip: 林先生和林太太是夫妻

grammar.q: The ____ on TV is Jolin. Her song is good.
grammar.tip: 有歌(song)→歌手 singer

grammar.q:
Eric: Hi, David. How are you?
David: Fine, thanks. ____
Eric: I'm fine. Thank you.
grammar.tip: 回答後反問對方：And you?

grammar.q:
Eric: ____ is my friend, Amy.
David: Nice to meet you, Amy.
grammar.tip: 介紹別人用 This is…

grammar.q:
David: Are you a nurse, Amy?
Amy: No, ____. I'm an English teacher.
grammar.tip: 否定簡答 I'm not；am not 不可縮寫

grammar.q: Amy: That tall man is my cousin. He is Aunt Milly's ____.
grammar.tip: 阿姨的兒子是表哥 → son

grammar.q:
May: ____ is he?
Amy: He is twenty-four years old.
grammar.tip: 回答年齡 → How old

grammar.q: Amy: My cousin is ____ old. He's a teacher.
grammar.tip: 幾歲：數字 + years old

grammar.q:
May: Is your cousin a student?
Amy: ____ He is a teacher.
grammar.tip: 他是老師不是學生→No, he isn't.

grammar.q: Amy: Nick and Ben are in Class 702. I'm ____ teacher.
grammar.tip: Nick and Ben = they → their

grammar.q: My mother ____ a housewife.
grammar.tip: My mother 第三人稱單數 → is

grammar.q: He is ____ office worker.
grammar.tip: office 母音開頭 → an

grammar.q: Zoe is ____ beautiful office worker.
grammar.tip: 冠詞看後面 beautiful，子音→a

grammar.q: Paul is a singer. He is old. → Paul is ____.
grammar.tip: a/an + 形容詞 + 名詞；old 母音→an

grammar.q: Max is a doctor. He is tall. → Max is ____.
grammar.tip: 形容詞放名詞前：a tall doctor

grammar.q:
A: Are you a doctor?
B: No, ____. I'm a nurse.
grammar.tip: you 問 I 答；am not 不能縮成 amn't

grammar.q:
A: Who is she?
B: ____
grammar.tip: Who 問句不用 Yes/No 回答

grammar.q:
A: Is Mrs. Brown a nurse?
B: No, ____. She's a doctor.
grammar.tip: Mrs. 是女性；否定 she's not

grammar.q:
A: How old is your baby brother?
B: ____
grammar.tip: 一歲用單數 year：one year old

grammar.q:
Zac: Is he your brother, Jamie?
Jamie: ____ He's my cousin, Max.
grammar.tip: 他是表哥不是哥哥 → No, he isn't.

grammar.q: That's Zac's sister. ____ name is Sophie.
grammar.tip: sister 女生，所有格 her + name

grammar.q: Look at that dog. ____ name is Lucky.
grammar.tip: 它的→Its；It's = It is

grammar.q: Yuki and Jamie are students. Zac is ____ new classmate.
grammar.tip: Yuki and Jamie = they → their

grammar.q:
A: ____ is that young woman?
B: She's my aunt.
grammar.tip: 問身分用 Who；Who's is 重複 be 動詞

grammar.q: ____ Kim Jamie's sister?
grammar.tip: Kim 單數，問句 Is 放句首

grammar.q: You and I ____ classmates.
grammar.tip: You and I = we → are

grammar.q: Mr. Parker is Jamie's dad. Mrs. Parker is Mr. Parker's ____.
grammar.tip: Parker 太太是 Parker 先生的妻子

grammar.q: Kim is Mr. and Mrs. Parker's ____. She is Jamie's sister.
grammar.tip: 女生、父母的孩子 → daughter

grammar.q: My mother's sister is my ____.
grammar.tip: 媽媽的姊妹 = aunt 阿姨

grammar.q:
A: ____ your cousin a police officer?
B: Yes, he is.
grammar.tip: your cousin 單數 → Is

grammar.q: My dad ____ a teacher. He's a writer.
grammar.tip: dad 單數否定 → isn't

grammar.q: ____ thirteen, and my sister is ten.
grammar.tip: 主詞 + be：I'm = I am

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
grammar.tip: 否定：she's not / she isn't

grammar.q: I am not a nurse. = ____
grammar.tip: am not 只能縮成 I'm not

grammar.q:
A: Are you and Ann sisters?
B: Yes, ____.
grammar.tip: you and Ann → 答 we；簡答不縮寫

grammar.q:
A: Is Ms. Chen tall?
B: No, she ____. She ____ short.
grammar.tip: 不高→isn't；她矮→is short

grammar.q: Tom is ____ junior high school student, and Amy is ____ elementary school student.
grammar.tip: junior 子音→a；elementary 母音→an

grammar.q:
A: Is Lucky a small dog?
B: No, ____. It's a big dog.
grammar.tip: Lucky 是狗→it；否定 it's not

sent.en: No, he isn't. He's my cousin, Max.
o: 不，他不是。他是我的表哥Max。
是的，他是。他是我的表哥Max。
不，他不是。他是你的表哥Max。
sent.tip: No, he isn't 否定；my 我的
Is 放句首 → 疑問句
數字 + years old = 幾歲

sent.en: No, I'm not. I'm a nurse.
She is not a tall girl.
We are a family of five.
My mom is an office worker.
sent.tip: My = 我的；office 前用 an

sent.en: My sister is an elementary school student, and I'm a junior high school student.
sent.hl: My sister is [[an]] elementary school student, and I'm [[a]] junior high school student.
o: 我妹妹是國中生，而我是國小生。
我妹妹不是國小生，而我是國中生。
我妹妹是國小生，而我是國中生。
sent.tip: elementary 國小；junior high 國中

sent.en: My family is very dear to me.
o: 我的家人對我來說非常珍貴。
你的家人對我來說非常珍貴。
我的家人對我來說不重要。
那位又漂亮又高的女人幾歲？
那位又漂亮又高的女人是你阿姨嗎？

sent.en: Julia is Mr. and Mrs. Wilson's daughter.
sent.hl: Julia is [[Mr. and Mrs. Wilson's]] daughter.
sent.tip: 名字's 表所有：Wilson 夫婦的
